title: VAHBench: A Harness Benchmark for Agentic Long-Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.20535v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents are commonly used for everyday information retrieval and coding. We ask whether they can also interpret human requests and turn them into complete videos. We introduce VAHBench, a benchmark that tests this ability through five short-drama briefs specifying story, characters, dialogue and duration. Agents plan and carry out production using shared generation tools. Evaluation combines video completeness and basic quality with checks of production reliability and reporting accuracy. Across 240 runs covering 48 configurations of general-purpose and video-specific agents, higher quality scores do not necessarily mean more complete delivery. Missing episodes, repeated footage and static filler reveal gaps between producing a video file and fulfilling the brief. Added composition tools help some agents but do not consistently improve performance. VAHBench measures how well agents translate user intent into finished video content and

translated_title: VAHBench：面向智能体长视频生成的评测基准
translated_abstract: AI智能体通常用于日常信息检索和编程。我们探讨它们是否也能理解人类请求并将其转化为完整的视频。我们提出了VAHBench，这是一个通过五个短剧集创作简报来测试这一能力的基准，简报中规定了故事、角色、对话和时长。智能体使用共享的生成工具来规划和执行制作。评估将视频完整性和基本质量与制作可靠性及报告准确性的检查相结合。在涵盖通用型和视频专用型智能体48种配置的240次运行中，更高的质量分数并不一定意味着更完整的交付。缺失的剧集、重复的素材和静态填充画面揭示了生成视频文件与完成创作简报之间的差距。添加合成工具对某些智能体有所帮助，但并不能持续提升性能。VAHBench衡量的是智能体将用户意图转化为成品视频内容的能力。
tldr: 提出了VAHBench基准，通过短剧集创作任务评测AI智能体将用户意图转化为完整长视频的能力，发现更高的画面质量并不等于完整交付，揭示了视频文件生成与创作需求达成之间的差距。
en_tdlr: Introduces VAHBench, a benchmark evaluating AI agents' ability to translate user intent into complete long-form videos through short-drama production briefs, revealing that higher quality scores do not necessarily mean more complete delivery.
